title: SV-11545 - Declined, Invoiced or Paid lead can't be changed (release)
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher.
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card from {Technician-A}'s column into {Technician-B}'s column.
  4. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card into the Unassigned column.
  5. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
  6. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column.
  7. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into the Unassigned column.
  8. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
  9. Drag {Work-order-4}'s card into {Technician-A}'s column.
  10. Drag {Work-order-4}'s card to a new place within the Unassigned column.
  11. Drag {Work-order-5}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
  12. Drag {Work-order-6}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
  13. Open {Work-order-2}.
  14. Try to change Lead Technician on the work order page.
  15. Go back to the Work Orders page.
  16. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  17. Do steps 3 to 10 again with the rows.
  18. Drag {Work-order-5}'s row from {Technician-A}'s group into {Technician-B}'s group.
  19. Drag {Work-order-6}'s row from {Technician-B}'s group back into {Technician-A}'s group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the All tab opens in Board View.
  • Step 2: only {Customer-A}'s six work orders show: {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2}, {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-5} and {Work-order-6} in {Technician-A}'s column, and {Work-order-4} in the Unassigned column.
  • Steps 3, 4, 6 and 7: {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} cannot be moved to {Technician-B} or to Unassigned: the card goes back to {Technician-A}'s column and the lead stays {Technician-A}. While {Work-order-2}'s card is over {Technician-B}'s column, the note "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned" shows at the top of that column; for {Work-order-3} it reads "Paid · can’t be reassigned".
  • Steps 5 and 8: {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} can be moved within {Technician-A}'s column and keep their new place.
  • Steps 9 and 10: {Work-order-4} cannot be moved out of Unassigned, but it can be reordered inside it.
  • Step 11: {Work-order-5} (Declined) cannot be moved to {Technician-B}: while its card is over {Technician-B}'s column the note “Declined · can’t be reassigned” shows at the top of that column, and the card goes back to {Technician-A}'s column.

    Step 12: {Work-order-6} (Complete) moves to {Technician-B} normally: its card now sits in {Technician-B}'s column.

  • Step 13: the work order page of {Work-order-2} opens.
  • Step 14: on the work order page the Lead Technician of {Work-order-2} cannot be changed either.
  • Step 15: the Work Orders page shows again.
  • Step 16: Tech View opens.
  • Steps 17 to 19: Tech View follows the same rules for every move (the note shows at the top of {Technician-B}'s group). A change sent outside the screens is also refused by the server; this part cannot be checked by hand, so write "server refusal not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see. Imported work orders are checked in their own case.

Release copy of C96963 (in the Fast-follow folder). It leaves out the message shown after {Work-order-6} moves to {Technician-B}, which waits on SV-11522 / SV-11524: Chris Ward (product owner) made these fast-follows for after the release (Slack, 20 Oct 2026, https://shopview.slack.com/archives/C0C41RV3T3L/p1792455057423139).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R10, S4-N2, S4-N6 and Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid, read 19 Oct 2026. In version 48 (12 Oct 2026) S4-N2 dropped Imported from the locked statuses (Imported work orders now open in List only); the Invoiced and Paid rules this case checks are unchanged, so the expected results are unchanged. Review Decisions DR-37 (Declined and Complete move freely) was replaced in PRD version 82 (29 Oct 2026, SV-11902): Declined now locks the lead technician; Complete still moves freely. PO answer to engineering, Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026 (Invoiced/Paid reorder within their technician or within Unassigned). In versions 66 to 68 (19 Oct 2026) the Invoiced or Paid rule was extended to Unassign and S4-N6 gave the drag note the design's words; the results of steps 3, 4, 6, 7 and 17 to 19 follow. Source-verified 19 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

PRD version 82 (29 Oct 2026, SV-11902; read 29 Oct 2026): a Declined work order now locks its lead technician exactly like an Invoiced or Paid one (S4-N2, S4-N6, S4-N7, S4-R32); Complete work orders still move freely. The results of steps 11 and 18 follow, and the quotes below are from version 82. The Declined behaviour was seen on the QA branch sv11902 (build v26.43.3-74314c9) on 29 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R10: “Enforce the prohibited-status rule in S4-N2 on every lead-change path, including requests that bypass interface controls.”
  • S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Declined, Invoiced or Paid status. A Declined, Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today. The lock follows the work order’s status at the moment of the change: a work order is Declined only while every one of its lines is declined, so when a line is re-approved or a new line is added and the work order becomes Estimate or Approved, its lead can change again. Only the work order’s own status counts: a declined line on a work order in any other status does not lock it.”
  • S4-N6: “On a Declined, Invoiced or Paid work order the Assign lead technician or Reassign lead technician action (S3-R14) and the Unassign action are disabled, and their tooltip reads “Declined · can’t be reassigned”, “Invoiced · can’t be reassigned” or “Paid · can’t be reassigned”, in the design’s format. The same words are the tooltip on the card’s or row’s lock icon, and the note shown at the top of another technician’s column or group while the work order is dragged over it, where the drop is refused.”
  • Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid: “Lead technician cannot be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid. This is a product rule, not only a screen rule, so it must hold on every path that changes the lead technician — board drag, the lead technician dialog, Unassign, Undo, and the work order detail page.”
